messages:
emma_pm: Quick thread to lock dependencies for Pilot-Forge (customer wants deterministic UI latency + tenant KMS). Need cross-team ok on routing+fallback, capacity lead time, and security gating before we give dates.
noah_runtime: Requesting concrete trace examples (prompt lengths, batch sizes). Also decide allowed fallback mode: degrade latency-first (quantize) or quality-first (queue/backpressure).
rachel_infra: Capacity: we can carve 3 dedicated GPUs (2 steady, 1 burst) if we get 21 days lead time. Prewarm soak = 72h. Network ask: does customer require VPC peering or is shared edge acceptable?
samira_sec: Security must see HSM attestation, proof of customer-managed KMS integration (no key export), and automated mTLS validation. Also require a log-scrub test in CI that proves key identifiers are never logged.
leo_eng: From product integration: feature flag gating + 5% canary for 24h, automatic rollback toggle, and blackbox quality checks against our eval set. I will add a smoke test harness in the repo.
noah_runtime: Proposal: latency-first fallback policy with transparent quality telemetry. If p99 > 1200ms for 5m, route new requests to quantized model and preserve KV cache. Canary fraction: 0.05 to start. Sample config: 
```
routing:
  policy: "latency"
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  fallback_trigger: "p99 > 1200ms"
  fallback_model: "forge-q4_0"
  preserve_kv: true
  prewarm: true
```
emma_pm: Draft acceptance criteria: - <=240ms p95 for interactive traces (<300 tokens) under nominal load - tenant-dedicated compute OR VPC peering + segregated logs - customer-managed KMS with attestation - documented failover with RTO <=5min - quality degradation measured: embedding cosine drop <0.06 vs baseline across eval set
rachel_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h at 1.2x expected load, ramp test to 4x for 15m. Will schedule after PO/LOI.
samira_sec: I'll produce a gating checklist including HSM attestation template, mTLS test steps, and CI log-scrub job by Wed. Also add requirement: no plaintext key material in snapshots/backups.
leo_eng: I'll land smoke tests and rollback script (rollback_to_release.sh) by Thu. Will wire quality webhooks.
noah_runtime: I'll publish the compatibility matrix (fp16, q4_0 supported; int8 experimental) and the routing runbook (including metric thresholds and manual overrides) by Tue.
emma_pm: Owners & due dates: noah_runtime -> routing/runbook + matrix (Tue); rachel_infra -> capacity hold + prewarm window (Wed); samira_sec -> gating checklist (Wed); leo_eng -> smoke tests + rollback (Thu); emma_pm -> finalize pilot acceptance doc and send to customer (Fri). hudson-bot: TASK-9001 created: "pilot-forge-onboard-playbook" and scheduled prewarm 2024-07-10 05:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
samira_sec: small nuance: require demonstration that key IDs are hashed before any logging pipeline. I'll add a CI step to verify.
noah_runtime: ack, will include a synthetic run that confirms log artifacts post-run are scrubbed.
emma_pm: Good. If owners meet dates we can propose a pilot start on 2024-07-17. Reconvene Fri 10:30am PT to sign off. Thanks all :thumbsup:
